Geographic Distribution

Explore geocoded sightings with a fully offline, pan-and-zoom coordinate map. Circles are placed at the mean coordinates of recorded sightings in each ZIP code, not ZIP polygon boundaries.

Sightings by ZIP
Low → High

Drag to pan · scroll or use +/− to zoom · click circles or pins for details. The basemap is a schematic geographic coordinate grid rather than online street tiles. Sample pins represent up to 6,500 geocoded cases from the source file.

Source: uploaded Rat_Sightings workbook. Case counts use all rows with a recognized borough. Closed means status = “Closed”. Resolution days are calculated only where both dates are valid and the close date is not earlier than the creation date. Monthly counts use valid creation dates. ZIP totals and sample pins require valid coordinates; records without coordinates remain included in summary and trends.
